claim: The dark stretch may come from an overloaded feed on market days.

evidence_refs.supports: Lists the lights on the ring road.

uncertainty: I do not know the exact numbers.
assumptions: I assume the register is up to date.
mechanism: More load trips the breaker, which darkens the whole stretch.
test_that_would_disprove_it: If the breaker log shows no trips, the overload idea is wrong.
